cli.plugin.author: author fingerprint: {fingerprint}
cli.plugin.reloadRequired: grants or config changed; reload required: spc plugin reload <plugin>
cli.plugin.promote.hint: ℹ️ {count} plugin(s) of the same author key ({author}) are in this source: consider giving it a dedicated bucket — packages signed by the same key will then land there automatically
cli.plugin.promote.cmd:
spc source add {bucket} --alias {alias} --anchor {pub}
  spc plugin reanchor {refs} --origin {bucket}
cli.plugin.grant.usage: Usage: spc plugin grant|revoke <plugin ID> <point>... (no wildcards)
cli.plugin.usage: Usage: spc plugin list | install <dir> | enable|disable|reload|uninstall <ID> | status <ID> | grant|revoke <ID> <point>... | reanchor <ref...> --origin <new source>
cli.reanchor.usage: Usage: spc plugin reanchor <full ref...> --origin <new source> [--yes] (prints a plan first, executes after confirmation)
cli.reanchor.anchor: author anchor: {fingerprint} (plugins moved here must be signed by this key)
cli.reanchor.needsReload: Needs reload to take effect (grants rewritten, plugin running): {refs}
cli.reanchor.idle: Enabled but not running dependents (affected on their next start): {refs}
cli.reanchor.blocked: Dependents are running; cannot move this one alone: {dependents} (include them in the command or stop them first)
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_TARGET_DISABL: ⚠️ Target source is disabled: {origin} (no update channel after the move)
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_BECOMES_ANCHO: ⚠️ Moving from a source with no update channel into the anchored source {origin}: **silent upgrades become possible** (a real trust upgrade)
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_KEEPS_CHANNEL: ℹ️ Target source {origin} is an anchored market source too: update channel unchanged
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_LOSES_CHANNEL: ⚠️ Moving to {origin}: **update channel is lost**; every upgrade will need a manual install and confirmation
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_ANCHOR_MATCHE: ℹ️ Target source's author anchor matches the plugin: {fingerprint}
cli.reanchor.warn.REANCHOR_IDLE_DEPENDEN: ℹ️ These dependents are enabled but not running; after the move they will see the dependency source changed on their next start: {refs}
cli.reanchor.notty: Not an interactive terminal: pass --yes to execute (so scripts never move plugins silently)
cli.reanchor.failedToStart: ⚠️ Moved but failed to start: {ref} ({code}) — retry with spc plugin reload
cli.source.usage: Usage: spc source list | add <origin> [--pub <source key>] [--alias <label>] [--anchor <author key>] | remove <origin> | enable|disable <origin> | alias <origin> <label> | anchor <origin> [--pub <author key>]
cli.source.pub.none: source key: not fetched yet (TOFU when the source is added or first used)
cli.source.anchor.none: author anchor: none (per-plugin first-seen via the author roster)
cli.source.anchor.stale: ⚠️ Changing the anchor only affects future installs: {count} plugin(s) in this source still follow the old anchor (reinstall or use reanchor to move them)
cli.handshake.verify.fail: Daemon signature verification failed — the peer may not be the real core (anti-impersonation)
cli.usage:
Usage: spc status | spc daemon stop | spc plugin <subcommand> | spc source <subcommand>
(SPC_PORT env var overrides default port {port})
cli.connect.fail: Cannot connect to core ({msg}). Is the core running?
daemon.key: [daemon] private key in memory only; public key {key}... (all sessions invalidated on restart)
daemon.root.deny: [daemon] refusing to run as root; start the core with a dedicated low-privilege user (e.g. spc).
daemon.shutdown.audit_pending: [daemon] WARNING: {count} audit entries could not be written; they will be lost when the process exits
audit.buffer.overflow: Audit buffer overflow (>{limit} bytes); audit chain broken, process exiting.
err.PLUGIN_LOAD_TIMEOUT: Plugin load timed out: {pluginId} (top-level code exceeded the {hook} budget)
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: Unauthenticated: session token invalid or expired
err.CHALLENGE_USED: Handshake nonce invalid or already used
err.PATH_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Path is outside the allowed scope: {path}
err.SYMLINK_DANGLING: Cannot resolve symlink (target does not exist): {path}
err.INODE_PRECHECK_MISSING: Internal error: inode check is missing the precheck value
err.INODE_MISMATCH: TOCTOU detected: file was replaced after validation
err.NOT_GRANTED: Permission not granted: {permission} (this permission requires a per-point admin grant)
err.LEVEL_ORDER_INVALID: Invalid definition for permission {permission}: executionLevel ({executionLevel}) is lower than confidentiality ({confidentiality})
err.PERMISSION_POINT_INVALID: Cannot derive a permission point name for {pluginId}: {value} ({reason})
err.SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Source not configured or unavailable: {origin} ({reason}) — for a local bucket run `spc source add <origin>` first, for a market source add it and fetch its key
err.SOURCE_ORIGIN_INVALID: Invalid source: {origin} (expected `local:<lowercase name>` or a market domain)
err.SOURCE_IN_USE: Source still owns plugins and cannot be removed: {origin} ({count} installed) — move or uninstall them first
err.SOURCE_BUILTIN: Built-in source cannot be removed: {origin} (the core seeds it on startup)
err.SOURCE_KEY_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to fetch the source key, source not added: {origin} ({reason})
err.SOURCE_ANCHOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This source cannot carry an author anchor: {origin} (a market is a multi-author namespace; only local buckets can be anchored)
err.SOURCE_PUB_NOT_APPLICABLE: A local bucket has no source key: {origin} (it signs nothing; use --anchor to bind an author)
err.KEY_ROTATION_UNVERIFIABLE: Locally trusted key is no longer in the list (possibly revoked); admin confirmation required: {fingerprint}
err.KEY_STATUS_ROLLBACK: Key status document is older than local record; rollback refused: {rotatedAt}
err.PACKAGE_META_MISSING: Distribution package is missing metadata or signature file
err.PACKAGE_ENVELOPE_INCOMPLETE: Incomplete package envelope: missing {file} (plugin.meta.json and plugin.author.sig must be provided together)
err.PACKAGE_AUTHOR_SIG_MISSING: Package is missing the author signature: {file}
err.PACKAGE_FILE_MISSING: File listed in manifest is missing: {path}
err.AUTHOR_MISMATCH: Author ID does not match namespace or source origin: {author}
err.AUTHORS_INVALID: Invalid author roster; refusing to use it: {file} ({reason})
err.TEMPLATE_DUPLICATE: Duplicate template or action.op already taken: {id}
err.TEMPLATE_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED: Executable is not inside the system directory allowlist: {command}
err.TEMPLATE_CWD_INVALID: Template cwd must be an absolute path: {cwd}
err.GRANT_WILDCARD: Grants do not accept wildcards or empty points: {permission} (list concrete permission points)
err.GRANT_NOT_APPLICABLE: Permission point {permission} is in the {grant} tier: it applies on install and cannot be granted or revoked (disable or uninstall the plugin to stop it)
err.RECORDS_INVALID: Invalid install records; refusing to start: {file} ({reason})
err.PLUGIN_REF_AMBIGUOUS: Ambiguous plugin reference: {input} matches several sources ({refs}) — use the full reference <origin>/<plugin id>
err.PLUGIN_SOURCE_INVALID: Invalid source: {origin} (expected `local:<name>` or a market domain)
err.PLUGIN_AUTHOR_MISMATCH: Author key does not match the recorded one: {pluginId} (expected {expected}, got {actual}); if this is the same author pass --accept-key-change, or install from a different source (--source)
err.PLUGIN_NO_ENTRY: Plugin does not export the required init function: {pluginId}
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Unmet plugin dependency: {pluginId} requires {dependency} (not installed or not enabled)
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_CHANGED: Unmet plugin dependency: {pluginId} requires {dependency}, but that source does not have it; ⚠️ a same-named plugin by the same author is at {foundAt} — if it changed source recently (reanchor / promote), move the dependents too or move it back
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY: Dependency author identity mismatch: {dependency} ({reason}; expected {expected}, got {actual})
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE: Invalid dependency declaration: {dependency} ({reason}; this plugin is from {self})
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_NOT_LOADED: Plugin dependency not ready: {dependency} required by {pluginId} is not running (state: {state}); start it first
err.PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: Plugin is in a dependency cycle; load order cannot be determined: {pluginId}
err.PLUGIN_IN_USE: Plugin is depended upon; operation refused: {pluginId} (dependents: {dependents}); disable or uninstall the dependents first
err.PLUGIN_ANCHOR_MISMATCH: The target source's author anchor does not match the plugin: {pluginId} (anchor of {origin} is {expected}, plugin is {actual}) — use another bucket, or change that bucket's anchor first (spc source anchor)
err.PLUGIN_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: Cannot decide which bucket to install into: the author key {author} anchors all of these ({origins}) — pass --source explicitly
err.PLUGIN_REANCHOR_FAILED: Failed to move files: {move} ({reason}); records were not modified, check the target location and retry
err.PLUGIN_STOP_TIMEOUT: Plugin stop timed out ({pluginId}): forced unload (the plugin is no longer awaited)
err.PLUGIN_MEMORY_LIMIT: Plugin exceeded its memory limit ({pluginId}): {limit} bytes
err.PLUGIN_STACK_LIMIT: Plugin exceeded its stack limit ({pluginId}): deep recursion intercepted
err.PLUGIN_TIMER_TIMEOUT: Plugin timer callback timed out ({pluginId}): interrupted
err.PLUGIN_BUSY: Plugin is busy; this call was rejected: {pluginId} (running {busyWith}); retry later
err.HANDLE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Plugin holds too many {kind} handles at once (limit {limit}): release them after use ({pluginId})
err.PLUGIN_CALL_HANDLE_UNKNOWN: Cross-plugin call rejected: {pluginId} has no dependency handle "{handle}"; declare the dependency in dependencies.plugins or use a declared handle
err.PLUGIN_CALL_PATH_NOT_DECLARED: Cross-plugin call rejected: {pluginId} never requested {path} (handle "{handle}"); add that endpoint to the dependency's call list
err.PLUGIN_CALL_NOT_CALLABLE: Cross-plugin call rejected: endpoint {path} of {callee} is not open to plugins; ask the author to declare callable including plugins
err.PLUGIN_CALL_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: Cross-plugin call failed: {callee} is not callable right now (state: {state}); start that plugin first
err.PLUGIN_CALL_TIMEOUT: Cross-plugin call timed out: endpoint {path} of {callee} did not finish within budget; interrupted, no partial result is returned
err.PLUGIN_CALL_FAILED: Cross-plugin call failed: endpoint {path} of {callee} threw ({cause})
err.PLUGIN_CALL_BAD_RESULT: Cross-plugin call failed: endpoint {path} of {callee} returned an invalid value ({reason}); an endpoint handler must return JSON text
err.PLUGIN_CALL_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: Cross-plugin call rejected: nesting reached the limit of {maxDepth} levels ({callee}); flatten the call chain instead of plugging calls into calls
err.TIMER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many timers (limit {limit}; clear some with timers.clear): {pluginId}
err.TIMER_HANDLER_INVALID: timers.every callback must be a function
err.KV_VALUE_INVALID: kv value is not valid JSON: {key}
err.NOT_A_FILE: Target is not a regular file: {path}
err.EVENT_TOPIC_NOT_DECLARED: Event topic is not declared in the manifest: {topic} ({pluginId})
